What we do

Fire protection services

One local team for every fire protection system in your building — homes, restaurants, warehouses, offices, retail and condos across Miami-Dade and Broward.

Fire Alarm Systems

Complete alarm systems that detect fire early and alert everyone in the building — designed around your property and kept working year-round.

  • Installation & upgrades
  • Repair & troubleshooting
  • Monitoring setup
  • Smoke & heat detectors, pull stations, panels
Request this service

Fire Sprinkler Systems

Sprinkler systems that react in seconds when a fire starts. We install new systems, fix leaks and damaged heads, and keep existing systems tested and ready.

  • New system installation
  • Leak & head repair
  • Scheduled inspections
  • Backflow & valve service
Request this service

Fire Suppression Systems

Automatic suppression for the places fire starts most: commercial kitchens, server rooms and other high-risk areas that water alone can't protect.

  • Kitchen hood suppression
  • Clean-agent systems
  • Recharge & refill service
  • Semi-annual service
Request this service

Fire Extinguishers

The right extinguisher, in the right place, ready when you grab it. We supply, place and service extinguishers for businesses and properties of every size.

  • Sales & placement
  • Annual inspections & tagging
  • Recharge & refill
  • Hydrostatic testing coordination

Inspections & Testing

Full fire safety inspections and system testing so your building is ready for the fire marshal, your insurer, and — most importantly — a real emergency.

  • Alarm & sprinkler testing
  • Exit signs & emergency lighting
  • Written condition report
  • Correction of failed items

Emergency Service

Alarm panel beeping, sprinkler leaking, system down after an incident? Call us at (786) 366-2729 — during business hours we work to get to you the same day.

  • Same-day response in business hours
  • Alarm trouble & false-alarm faults
  • Sprinkler leaks & broken heads
  • Post-incident system checks

Fire protection emergency?

If your alarm panel is in trouble, a sprinkler is leaking, or a system is down, call now. During business hours, we work to reach you the same day. If there is an active fire, call 911 first.

Why FireCore

Why choose FireCore Safety

Straightforward fire protection: we come to you, inspect for free, explain what we find in plain language, and only then talk about the work.

Free inspection

We look at your systems on site at no cost and tell you exactly what is working, what is not, and what can wait. No charge to find out where you stand.

Same-day, in business hours

Call during business hours and we work to get a technician to your property the same day — no waiting days for a callback.

On-site service, always

Fire protection can't be fixed over the phone. Every inspection, test and repair happens in person, at your property.

Every system, one call

Alarms, sprinklers, suppression and extinguishers handled by a single team — one visit can cover your whole fire protection setup.

Local Miami & Broward team

We're based in South Florida and work across Miami-Dade and Broward every day — we know the buildings, the codes and the inspectors' expectations here.

English & Spanish
